name: B5·2 Staff & Compliance — sales leaderboard + KYC high-value alert + renewal/GST deadline reminders (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Tabs: **StaffSales** (Date, Staff, Amount, Item) — staff log each sale (or feed from B5·1's webhook); **Compliance** (Item, DueDate, Notes) — add rows like 'GST GSTR-1' 11th monthly, 'GST GSTR-3B' 20th monthly, 'BIS licence renewal', 'Insurance policy renewal', 'Weights & Measures calibration', 'Fire NOC'.
2. Variables: TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID, KYC_LIMIT (default 200000). Attach Telegram + Sheets creds; replace REPLACE_SHEET_ID.
3. High-value watch listens to the SAME `sale-in` webhook as B5·1 (import both; n8n allows one path per workflow — so here it is `sale-in-kyc`; POST sales to BOTH, or chain B5·1 → HTTP node → this).

## HOW IT RUNS
• **Sat 20:00** — weekly staff leaderboard 🏆 (total + count per staff) → Telegram. Friendly competition = more sales.
• **Sale ≥ KYC_LIMIT** → instant ⚠ 'collect PAN/Aadhaar' reminder (Rule 114B: PAN mandatory for jewellery purchases above ₹2,00,000).
• **Daily 08:15** — any Compliance row due in ≤7 days → reminder with days-left.

## 🔧 FIX
• Leaderboard empty → StaffSales has no rows this week.
• KYC alerts too frequent → raise KYC_LIMIT.
• Recurring GST rows → after each filing, bump DueDate to next month.
